scientific_integrity: Earlier exact Bernstein–Durrmeyer eigenstructure and qualitative semigroup convergence are acknowledged; a historically inaccessible full text leaves residual priority uncertainty. Computational tests support but do not prove infinite-dimensional asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed simplex dimension, strictly positive Dirichlet parameters, and positive diffusion time. Uniformity only on compact subintervals of positive times. The fixed additive shift is uniquely optimal within that clock family; fractional spectral powers are not claimed Markov-positive.
title: Multivariate all-Schatten fourth-order expansion for centered Dirichlet–Durrmeyer semigroup powers
